images.subject: a large futuristic metal mining complex built around one wide drilling shaft sinking into the ground
images.detail: Veins of raw silver and copper ore cut through the surrounding rock.

images.subject: a large futuristic crystal mining complex built around a wide excavation
images.detail: Huge clusters of pale blue crystal grow out of the exposed rock around it.

images.subject: a large futuristic deuterium synthesis plant built around a cluster of spherical pressure tanks
images.detail: Thick insulated pipes connect the tanks to the surrounding machinery.

images.subject: a large futuristic solar power station made of wide tilted arrays of dark solar panels
images.detail: The panel arrays radiate outward from a central control structure.

images.subject: a large futuristic spaceship construction yard built around one giant open gantry
images.detail: An unfinished spaceship hull sits inside the gantry, its frame partly exposed.

images.subject: a large futuristic research laboratory complex built around one large observation dome
images.detail: A ring of radio antennas surrounds the dome.
